arrival.write: If you found it, please write to {contact}.

device.title: Is this your phone?
device.lead: Asked once. You can change it later in settings.
device.yesText: The voices stay on this phone, even without internet.
device.noText: Nothing is kept. Tap the stone again to listen again.

lock.title: This pebbble is locked
lock.lead: Its voices open with a word you know.
lock.wrong: Not quite. Read the hint again.

player.slept: Paused by the sleep timer. Good night.

library.title: My pebbbles
library.emptyText: Touch the back of your phone with the stone. Its voices open here.
library.iphone: iPhone: keep the screen unlocked, hold the stone near the top, then tap the notification.

menu.label: This pebbble
menu.editText: Add voices, rename, change the password. Only on your phone.
menu.forgetText: Its voices leave this phone. The stone keeps them: tap it to bring them back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.mineText: Keeps voices here for listening offline.
settings.notMineText: Keeps nothing. Everything is gone when closed.
settings.clear: Remove saved voices from this phone
settings.clearConfirm: Remove the saved voices from this phone?
settings.nowMine: Voices will be kept on this phone
settings.nowNotMine: Nothing is kept on this phone

status.cannotOpen: This stone could not be opened.
status.empty: This pebbble has no voices yet.

install.title: Keep Pebbble on this phone
install.text: Add it to your home screen. It opens even without internet, and the voices stay safe here.
install.ios: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

writer.title: Writer
writer.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
writer.notFound: No pebbble found at this link.
writer.wrongLink: This link does not open that pebbble.
writer.offline: Could not reach the storage. Check the connection.

welcome.title: Where should the voices live?
welcome.lead: Pebbbles keep their voices, encrypted, in your own storage. Connect it once on this device.
welcome.pasteText: Made on a device where the writer is already set up.
welcome.guideText: A guided walk through Cloudflare, about 10 minutes.

guide.title: Set up your storage
guide.lead: Cloudflare R2 keeps the encrypted voices. The free tier is plenty. Open dash.cloudflare.com in another tab.
guide.s1Text: R2 → Create bucket. Any name works.
guide.s2Text: In the bucket: Settings → Public access → allow the r2.dev address, then paste it here. The files stay encrypted: public only means a stone can fetch them.
guide.cors: In the same settings, under CORS policy, paste this rule so the apps may read and save:
guide.s3Text: R2 → Manage API tokens → Create token, with Object Read & Write on this bucket only. Paste what Cloudflare shows.
guide.badKey: Cloudflare refused the key. Check the S3 address, the access key and the secret.
guide.badPublic: Saving works, but the public address doesn't show the bucket. Check step 2 and its CORS rule.

paste.title: Paste a setup code
paste.lead: On the device that is already set up: Settings → Set up another device. Copy the code, send it to yourself, and paste it here.
paste.bad: That is not a setup code. It starts with “pebbble-setup:”.

key.title: Choose a key phrase
key.lead: It opens your list of pebbbles on every device you set up. Use the same phrase everywhere. It is never saved or sent.
key.leadJoin: The one you chose on your other device. It opens the setup code and your list of pebbbles.
key.placeholder: Four or five words you'll remember
key.lose: Lose it and the list is gone, but the stones keep working: you can reopen each one by holding it to the phone.
key.wrong: This key phrase doesn't open that code.

library.tap: Hold a stone to the back of the phone to open it here.
library.listening: Listening… hold the stone to the back of the phone.
library.noNfc: Stones can be opened here with Chrome on Android. On this device, paste a pebbble's link.
library.pasteLink: Open a pebbble by its link
library.cannotScan: Could not read stones. Allow NFC for this site and try again.

link.title: Open by link
link.lead: Paste the link written on the stone.
link.bad: That is not a pebbble link.

unlock.lead: Its voices are locked. The hint says:

editor.name: Pebbble name
editor.preview: What people see when they tap
editor.pwOff: None. Holding the stone is enough.

voice.title: Title
voice.alwaysNote: Anyone who taps the stone can hear it.
voice.fromNote: It sleeps until that day, then stays awake for good.
voice.yearlyNote: It wakes every year for those days, then sleeps again.
voice.needAudio: Record a voice or choose a file first.
voice.noMic: The microphone is not available. Allow it for this site, or choose a file.
voice.badFile: This file can't be played. Try another one.
voice.cannotPlay: This voice could not be played.

pw.title: Password
pw.lead: Optional. Without it, holding the stone is enough to listen.
pw.keepEmpty: Leave empty to keep the current one
pw.forgiving: Capitals, extra spaces and accents don't matter (é = e). Digits and symbols must match.
pw.hintPlaceholder: What you throw in the river

found.title: If someone finds it
found.lead: Anyone who taps the stone sees this, even without the password.
found.contactPlaceholder: An email or a phone number
found.nothing: Nothing yet. Without a contact, a lost stone can't find its way back.

save.andWrite: Save and write to a stone
save.saved: Saved. The stone plays the new version.
save.savedWriteLater: Saved. Open it on your phone to write it to a stone.
save.failed: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.

write.title: Hold the stone to the back of your phone
write.text: Keep it still until the phone buzzes. It takes a second.
write.failed: The stone could not be written. Hold it still, a little higher on the phone.

written.title: “{name}” is in the stone
written.text: Tap it with any phone to listen.

lock.title: Lock the tag
lock.text: Stops anyone from rewriting what the stone points to. Do this only once its address is final.
lock.confirmText: No phone will ever rewrite it, including yours. Voices can still be added and changed. This can't be undone.
lock.hold: Hold the stone to the phone again…
lock.doneText: The stone keeps this address for good.
lock.failed: The tag could not be locked.

settings.shareText: A code to paste there, opened by your key phrase.
settings.disconnectConfirm: Tap again to disconnect. Stones keep working.

share.title: Set up another device
share.lead: On the other device, choose “Paste a setup code”, paste this, then type your key phrase. Without the key phrase the code opens nothing.
